rv.q: Whatever the truth, Wright’s interpretation makes for compelling theatre.
For all that, PLEASE PLEASE ME certainly parades a good deal of heart and effort, wrapped neatly in a compelling dose of nostalgia.

cn.t: Critics find this Brian Epstein biopic a worthy spotlight on the Beatles' oft-overlooked manager, with reviewers praising its focus on the shy impresario who discovered and shaped the Fab Four, though both suggest untapped dramatic potential.
